data.name: CustomerSuppliedWrongLocation
data.value: Customer-supplied movement {0} sits at location {1}, which is not a customer-supplied warehouse (warehouse type CustomerSupplied). Customer-owned stock is the customer's property; held in a normal warehouse it enters the moving-average denominator, understates our own unit cost, and propagates into the cost of goods sold of every later shipment. The posting guard prevents new occurrences, so these are legacy rows: transfer the stock into a customer-supplied warehouse.
